article.story: OLEAN, N.Y. -- — Zach Anderson had 17 points in George Mason's 75-62 win against St. Bonaventure on Tuesday night. Anderson shot 6 for 9, including 5 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Patriots (15-5, 6-1 Atlantic 10 Conference). Darius Maddox scored 14 points and added seven rebounds. Brayden O'Connor shot 2 of 6 from the field and 8 for 8 from the line to finish with 13 points. Melvin Council Jr. finished with 18 points, six rebounds and four assists for the Bonnies (15-5, 3-4). St. Bonaventure also got 16 points and seven rebounds from Duane Thompson. Anderson led his team in scoring with 12 points in the first half to help put them up 45-31 at the break. Maddox led the way with a team-high nine second-half points. George Mason's next game is Wednesday against Loyola Chicago at home. St. Bonaventure visits VCU on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
